Name: Medieval Villagers
Author: unclesamscienceman
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]I installed the full setup of  Daisy's Earthy Recolor, Medieval buildings, Way Back Pelican Town, and Gwen's Medieval Craftables. Super cozy and atmospheric. And then, I talked to Alex, and his letter jacket stuck out like a sore thumb. So I asked myself: Is there a Medieval Villagers mod? The answer at the time was no. I wondered why, but several months of editing portraits and sprites later, I don't wonder anymore, because now I understand how massive of an undertaking editing almost every NPC in this game is. Also, because now there is one![/size][/color]

Currently, each villager has one outfit all year round. Almost every villager has been overhauled completely, but a few have just had minor tweaks, and three of them had pretty medieval looks already (Linus and Leo's Winter outfits, and Willy's default outfit), in which case I left them in that outfit year round.

[b]Also of note:[/b] This mod is not currently SDVE compatible. It is, however, completely configurable. If there is a specific character that you would like to revert to vanilla, or keep your preferred mod of, you can go into your mod config, scroll down to Medieval Villagers, and uncheck just that specific character.

[b][size=4]Future Plans[/size][/b]
[size=3]First, I will be making seasonal variants of outfits. This will be the largest undertaking, so it might be a while until that update happens, but I will promote it on Reddit when it happens. I am u/anarchomoth over there if you want to follow so you can know when that update drops. This is technically a full complete mod, but I realized within hours of posting that I won't consider it polished and done until characters at least have unique winter outfits.  [/size]

I still need to ask the mod authors permission, but I think that I would also like to make medieval outfits for the the SDVE characters, and also for the Diverse and the Furry variants of the villagers.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Make sure you have SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Generic Mod Config Menu installed alongside this one, and that you run the game at least once with this mod installed to generate the config file.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Daisy Niko's Earthy Recolor[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]Medieval Buildings[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5513]Gwen's Medieval Craftables[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7332]Way Back Pelican Town[/url]

Truly, you all have inspired me to add to the medieval collection and I hope I have created a worthy entry to it.

I also want to shout out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098]Rustic Interiors [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17323]Lavender Dreams UI[/url], since their mods are visually featured in my screenshots, and also Bog's Fantasy [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34858]Marnie[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40524]Maru[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34756]Caroline[/url] edits, which fit the bill for the witchy medieval vibe, and are absolutely worth installing and toggling off those villagers in the settings of my mod.
